## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

As a Website Visitor, I want to see authentic testimonials from other customers So that I can trust the company and make informed decisions about their services

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:clipboard:</custom> Global Requirements

* The testimonial component should be able to display multiple slides that can be navigated
* The component should also be able to be used as a single quote
* Navigation controls should be visible and easy to use
* The component should be responsive and work well on all device sizes
* Images and videos should be optimized for web performance
* It is possible to place the component in a single row or in a multi-column layout

    * If it is used in a multi-column layout, it dynamically adjusts sizes etc.
    

### Technical Requirements:

* Responsive design implementation
* Proper content management system integration for easy updates
* **add technical requirements here**

### Definition of Done:

* Component is fully responsive and tested across different devices
* All navigation controls are working properly
* Content management system allows easy addition/editing of testimonials
* Performance tests show optimal loading times for images and videos
* Accessibility requirements are met
* Code has been reviewed and approved

---

## CMS Testimonial Persona Quote

This component is particularly eye-catching and can only be used if you also have profile pictures, as the design is based on this visual element. If you do not have any pictures, you should use the Quote Card.

[https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=7389-38139&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-4](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=7389-38139&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-4) 

#### **Requirements:**

* Each slide contains:

    * A profile picture 
    * A testimonial quote text
    * The person's first and last name
    * Their current position (optional)
    * Their company name
    * Their Company Logo (optional)
    
* Slide transitions are animated to match the [mobile dummy ](https://www.figma.com/proto/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6904-152633&p=f&viewport=603%2C292%2C0.1&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-0&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=7383%3A37011&show-proto-sidebar=1)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-2">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/proto/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6904-152633&p=f&viewport=603%2C292%2C0.1&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-0&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=7383%3A37011&show-proto-sidebar=1) and [desktop dummy ](https://www.figma.com/proto/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6904-152633&p=f&viewport=603%2C292%2C0.1&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-0&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=7389%3A37651&show-proto-sidebar=1)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-3">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/proto/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6904-152633&p=f&viewport=603%2C292%2C0.1&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-0&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=7389%3A37651&show-proto-sidebar=1)
* Quotes can have light, dark oder bright background with the according text and ui element colors

* You can choose between [three styles for the profile picture](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=7368-32242&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-4):

    * Speech Bubble
    * Round
    * Square
    * The Speech Bubble Style has a different corner radius on mobile and desktop 
    

![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=7f522f1e-c7aa-40de-a77a-7e70aeed9131&&collection=&height=495&occurrenceKey=null&width=326&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
* Height of each slide adjusts to the height of the highest slide

    * There are no max. characters, but we recommend approx. 200 characters.
    
* Logos sizes:

    * square or portrait logos have a max height of 50px
    * rectangle logos have a max width of 130px and should have a height of 30px
    * logo safe area is 130x50 px
    
* If one slide has no logo, but the others have a logo, the layout remains default
* If all slides have no logo, the layout changes to "no logos":

longDescription:
## Purpose

The Persona Quote component enables website visitors to see authentic testimonials from satisfied customers, building trust and helping them make informed decisions about services. This component is particularly effective when visual content is available, as the design centers around prominent profile pictures.

## Use Cases

- Display multiple testimonial slides with animated navigation controls on landing pages
- Showcase individual customer stories in single quote mode within content sections
- Present testimonials in multi-column layouts with automatic size adjustment
- Feature testimonials from various industries with optional company logos and job titles

## Design Rationale

The component prioritizes visual engagement because users are more likely to connect with content featuring real people. The three profile picture styles (speech bubble, round, square) allow design flexibility while maintaining focus on the human element. The adaptive layout system gracefully handles missing optional elements like logos, ensuring consistent presentation regardless of available content.
